limitations: This validation ran a bounded 200 km Sacramento uniform grid, not the full fixed-grid versus adaptive-beam benchmark across all priors and refinement levels.

The bank preserves the 1316-node propagation validity screen while retaining 209 geometry nodes. Per-cell coarse-projection and candidate-array work must be recorded by the full benchmark before claiming an end-to-end 6.3x speedup.

Adaptive basin search is heuristic. It has no global best-cell guarantee without an admissible spatial upper bound. Benchmark beam widths against the fixed-partition exhaustive final lattice and report missed-mode recall and objective gap.
